messages.author: 638816215a1b49a4
messages.subject: Re: Video
parts:
Any suggestions on how to incorporate video files (AVI) into cameratrapR? Is there a way to convert AVI to JPG for analysis? I have a few folders/camera stations that have video only recordings.

Thank you,
Ali

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Video
parts: Currently avi files are not supported. If you cameras can record jpgs along with the avis (i.e. one image for every video), you can import the jpgs in camtrapR and work with them normally. Otherwise, I am not aware of a straightforward solution for working with video files in camtrapR.

Update: I just read that digiKam 6.0, which is available as beta, will introduce full video support. I hope that the developers found a clever way of reliably extracting date and time information, which was what prevented video support in camtrapR.
